name: maws-spike-zoom-probe
description: Spike (UX wave U6b-5b, M1): what Chromium keeps of a window's zoom, in each zoom mode, across a quit and a forced exit; how a factor is in force before the first show; what a child view and a second window take. Findings only, never product code. Runs on the repository's own Electron (the root's node_modules); no dependencies of its own.
